2: name: hybrid-mobile-architecture
3: description: Build, adopt, upgrade, and audit governed agentic applications with Flutter, Tauri, React, Axum, Rust, Universal Agent Runtime, A2UI/AG-UI, and Prometheus Entity Management. Use for KnowMe Builder projects, hybrid mobile or desktop apps, governed web shells, UAR integration, typed native bridges, agent-tool security, or non-destructive application generation.
4: ---
5: 
6: # KnowMe Builder
7: 
8: Create, adopt, extend, and maintain governed agentic applications. UAR owns
9: agent execution, run lifecycle, model routing, and tool governance. Prometheus
10: owns development workflow lifecycle and cross-harness coordination. The
11: Builder owns application architecture, typed adapters, generation, skills, and
12: conformance tests.
13: 
14: ## Distribution boundary
15: 
16: This standalone skill contains the architecture references needed for design and
17: review. Executable generation, environment remediation, and maintained templates
18: belong to the versioned `knowme-builder` CLI and the trusted source checkout.
19: Never assume repository scripts or templates exist beside an individually
20: installed skill. Use the public installation guide at
21: <https://know-me-tools.github.io/hybrid-mobile-architecture-skill/reference/installation>
22: when the CLI or native harness package is required.
23: 
24: ## Quick orientation
25: 
26: Read the architectural standard document before any substantial work:
27: `references/arch-standard.md` — this is the decision-making authority.
28: 
29: For platform-specific deep dives:
30: - Flutter patterns → `references/flutter/patterns.md`
31: - Tauri/React patterns → `references/tauri/patterns.md`
32: - Rust core patterns → `references/rust/patterns.md`
33: - Auth patterns → `references/auth/patterns.md`
34: 
35: ---
36: 
37: ## Step 1 — Environment and contract check
38: 
39: Before any generation or adoption, run:
40: 
41: ```bash
42: knowme-builder doctor --json
43: ```
44: 
45: The source checkout also provides `scripts/check-env.mjs` for maintainers. An
46: individually installed skill must use `knowme-builder doctor --json` instead.
47: 
48: ### Required tool matrix
49: 
50: | Tool | Minimum Version | Install command |
51: |------|----------------|-----------------|
52: | Rust + Cargo | 1.97.1 | `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs \| sh` |
53: | Flutter SDK | beta channel, latest | Follow the public installation guide |
54: | Node.js | 26.5.0 (current release — pin, not `--lts`) | `curl -fsSL https://fnm.vercel.app/install \| bash && fnm install 26` |
55: | Tauri CLI | 2.10+ | `cargo install tauri-cli --version "^2"` |
56: | flutter_rust_bridge_codegen | 2.12+ | `cargo install flutter_rust_bridge_codegen` |
57: | cargo-ndk | latest | `cargo install cargo-ndk` (Android only) |
58: | create-tauri-app | latest | `npm create tauri-app@latest` |
59: 
60: Do not attempt environment remediation unless the user explicitly requests it.
61: 
62: ---
63: 
64: ## Step 2 — Determine the operation
65: 
66: Infer the operation from the request and existing project state; ask only when the
67: choice is ambiguous. Read `references/project-evolution.md` for greenfield,
68: brownfield and ongoing upgrade workflows.
69: 
70: ### 2a. New project
71: 
72: Require an explicit profile and generation mode:
73: 
74: ```bash
75: knowme-builder new <path> --profile <profile> --mode runnable|skeleton
76: ```
77: 
78: Profiles are `sovereign-hybrid`, `governed-web-shell`, `flutter-mobile`,
79: `tauri-desktop`, and `axum-web`.
80: 
81: For a host-certification attempt, repeat `--target <triple>` for every native
82: target and add `--verify-ffi` for Flutter/Rust FFI. Missing requested
83: prerequisites must fail before the destination is written. Omitting these flags
84: generates complete runnable source but does not claim host certification.
85: 
86: ### 2b. Existing application adoption
87: 
88: Never re-scaffold an evolved application. Preview first, then apply:
89: 
90: ```bash
91: knowme-builder adopt <path> --profile <profile> --check
92: knowme-builder adopt <path> --profile <profile> --apply
93: ```
94: 
95: The preview result reports `detectedSurfaces`, `missingSurfaces`,
96: `integrationSteps`, and conflicts so the architecture inventory remains useful
97: without creating adoption metadata.
98: 
99: Inventory actual source roots, entrypoints, dependencies, persistence and native
100: bridges first. Adoption metadata is not proof that missing layers or surfaces
101: were implemented. Preserve existing application behavior and user-owned files.
102: Apply requested architecture changes as bounded migrations with an executable
103: feature through the existing layers; do not replace the application with a new
104: scaffold or call disconnected generated snippets an integration.
